events.address: Mulberry Street between Canal Street and East Houston Street, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: The centennial edition of Little Italy's 11-day Feast of San Gennaro, with hundreds of food and merchandise vendors, carnival games, live entertainment, religious programming and processions across the Little Italy street-festival footprint.
events.what_is_free: Admission and walking the street festival are free. Food, drinks, carnival games and merchandise are sold separately.
events.caveats: Free admission does not include food, drinks, games or merchandise. The festival spans multiple Little Italy streets rather than a single venue. Individual stage performances and procession times have their own schedules; check the official calendar for specific programming.
events.practical_notes: The official organizer confirms Sept. 17–27, 2026. CBS New York reports public festival hours of 11:30 AM–11 PM, extended to midnight Fridays and Saturdays. The main footprint is Mulberry Street between Canal and East Houston, with additional festival areas on Hester and Grand streets.
